light-bark.summary: Dry-brush Birch white sunlight down the left side of each birch trunk.
light-bark.tip: The light comes from the upper left, so skim the Birch white down the left side of each birch only, pulling from the top down, and leave the right side of each trunk in shade. Most of it goes on the two big birches in the left half of the canvas, as the after picture shows. Skip over the dark bark patches and let them show through.

tap-sunlit-leaves.summary: Tap Pale gold sunlit leaves across the path and the front of the ground.
tap-sunlit-leaves.tip: Most of the Pale gold goes in the right half, thickest on the path, where the after picture has it, with only a few scattered leaves near the left edge. Tap separate leaf-sized dabs, not a solid band, and leave the darker leaves showing between them so the ground still reads as a pile of leaves.
